Rite Of Repulsion: ingredients 
 
 Ingredients: 
 1 lapis lazuli block 
 1 glowing item frame 
 1 echo shard

Rite Of Repulsion: 
 setup 
 
 - Place the lapis lazuli block 
 - Place the glowing item frame on top of the lapis lazuli block 
 - Enchant the echo shard with cursing 
 - Place it in the glowing item frame 
 - Click the lapis lazuli block with the Holy Wand

Banishing 
 
 Banishing is a new enchantment applied to any swords, when you hit a ghost with it, the ghost become vulnerable

Holy Wand 
 
 The Holy Wand is a wand that help you for the Rite Of Repulsion for now 
 
 To craft it, imbue a stick with 8 prismarine shards

Rite Of Blessing: ingredients 
 
 Ingredients: 
 5 gold block 
 4 redstone block 
 1 gold ingot

Rite Of Blessing: 
 setup 
 
 - Place a gold block and 4 redstone block around it 
 - Place gold blocks on the corners 
 - Rename the gold ingot "expulsio spectri" 
 - Throw the gold ingot at the center of the hotel
